questions.question: In the parable of the workers in the vineyard, how much were the last workers hired paid?
The mother of James and John asked Jesus for what?
options: That her sons be granted long life and great riches
That her sons sit at his right and left hand in his kingdom
That her sons be kept safe from all harm and danger
That her sons be healed of a sickness that long troubled them
questions.answer: That her sons sit at his right and left hand in his kingdom

questions.question: The other ten disciples were pleased when they heard James and John's mother's request.
